//: Mobile performance budget for Airen. There is no CI runner in this repo yet, so this file is the budget rather than a pipeline: run it locally with `npx -y @lhci/cli@0.15.1 autorun` against a production build. Reports stay on disk in `.lighthouseci/` (gitignored): the earlier `temporary-public-storage` target published every report to a public URL. When CI exists, wire the same command into it unchanged. Comment keys inside `assertions` are parsed by LHCI as audit names and fail as `auditRan`, so the reasoning lives up here. CLS is an error rather than a warning because a skeleton or a late font swap can silently ruin it, and it is the metric that makes a fast page feel broken.

settings.//: Emulated mobile is the target, not desktop. The `mobile` preset throttles CPU and network, which is the only honest way to measure a phone.
